name: AP_STATEMENT_LINES
description: This table contains information about the statement lines.

columns.name: STATMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the statement line.

columns.name: STATEMENT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the statement header.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Statement status after program completion. Values based on the lookup type ORA_AP_STATEMENT_PROCESS_STATUS.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application that processes the statement.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: PAYMENT_REFERENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment reference number of the original transaction.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the amount in statement line.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_CURRENCY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Original amount in the statement.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date when the transaction is processed by supplier.

columns.name: POSTED_DATE
columns.description: Date when the transaction is posted on the customer account.

columns.name: POSTED_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the transactions posted on the customer account.

columns.name: POSTED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Transaction amount in posted currency.

columns.name: POSTED_EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Factor used to convert an amount from transaction to posted currency.

columns.name: POSTED_EXCHANGE_TYPE
columns.description: Rate type for the posted rate in statement line.

columns.name: POSTED_EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Date and time when  the posted rate is quoted.

columns.name: BILLING_DATE
columns.description: Date and time when  the transaction is billed

columns.name: BILLING_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the transactions billed to the customer account.

columns.name: BILLING_AMOUNT
columns.description: Transaction amount in billed currency.

columns.name: BILLING_EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Factor used to convert an amount from transaction to billed currency.

columns.name: BILLING_EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Rate type for the billed rate in statement line.

columns.name: BILLING_EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Date and time when  the billed rate is quoted.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Alphanumeric code that identifies transaction.

columns.name: DEBIT_CREDIT_INDICATOR
columns.description: Indicates whether the line amount is positive or negative. Positive amount implies a credit whereas negative amount indicates a debit.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_CODE
columns.description: Transaction code given in the statement.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the statement line amount.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_AMOUNT1
columns.description: Amount in statement line currency.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_AMOUNT2
columns.description: Amount in statement line currency.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_AMOUNT3
columns.description: Amount in statement line currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Factor used to convert an amount from one currency to another.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Date and time when  the rate is quoted.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Rate type in the statement line.
